findings.statement: The D-062 r2 trajectory report (sha256 fc6f98bd, verdict FAIL, exit 10, wall 22862 s) was verified check-by-check: exactly two checks fail - T8_spectrum (sup_rel 2.0800641747e-3 vs band 2e-3) and T10_mutants (both kills false, both modes 'activity floor unmet at all mutant samples') - while the other ten checks pass with recorded margins, the base endpoint (N_eff 3.034054308076679, N_end 7.936698865363719, t 52678.7319 s, 3694 evals) is a bitwise deterministic replay of the preserved D-056 report, its deltas vs the completed-catalogue BDF anchor (+1.832e-5, +5.53e-6, +1.10 s vs bands 3e-4, 1e-4, 5 s) REJECT the obsolete-anchor class (7.44e-4), and the rtol 3e-7 holdout converges (4331 evals, dNeff -1.199e-5 vs 2e-4, dN 8.4e-7, dt -0.71 s), with T5/T7-split/T9/T11 margins reproduced (Rodas dNeff 1.499e-4, split delta 1.8019e-5 vs 2e-4, max R_total 6.97e-5 vs 5e-4 with 4 >= 4 clean checkpoints, tail 1.24e-8, rejections in envelope, roundoff 0). Both failures are frozen-parameter contract-design defects of the D-054/D-060 class, not physics: the T8 sup occurs at Rust node 0 (y=0.00184, e flavour), one of only two nodes (with node 1, y=0.00972) below the first GL48 collocation node (~0.01475), so the gate measures the independent representation's polynomial extrapolation outside its collocation support at negligible y^2-measure weight (in-support sup 1.588e-3, inside the band); and the frozen T10 restart at N=4.00 sits where the measured base heating activity |dW_nu/dN|/W_nu is 3.8e-4 - already below the 5e-4 activity floor, with all six mutant FD samples at 2.77e-4 to 3.45e-4 - so both kills were structurally unreachable and the inconclusive-SURVIVED is fail-closed bookkeeping, not surviving physics (the measured activity peaks at ~2.4e-3 at N=2.00); neither defect implicates the physics, the catalogue, the anchors, or the integrator. The r2 FAIL is preserved unchanged; a D-063 r3 reissue may supersede it by changing EXACTLY TWO items - (1) gate T8 on Rust nodes with y >= GRID.nodes[0], with sub-support deviations recorded non-gating and the full-domain sup retained, and (2) relocate the mutant restart to the measured activity peak N=2.00 (span [2.00, 2.20], FD samples {2.05, 2.10, 2.15}) - with every band, threshold, floor, anchor, and formula otherwise unchanged and a full fresh re-execution of the frozen sequence.
